title: Scenario
description: An engine-neutral test: a map, a start, a timeline of inputs, and expectations. Times are in seconds and convert to ticks as described in scenarios/README.md.

description.description: What the scenario shows, in a sentence or two.

status.description: unverified: written without an engine run; expectations may be tuned once on first run. verified: an engine has passed it; expectations change only for intentional behavior changes.

seed.description: Seed for the sim's RNG. Defaults to 0.

duration.description: Total time to simulate, in seconds.

start.description: The player spawns at the marker's origin raised by 1 unit, at rest, holding the starting weapon ready to fire; the first tick settles it onto the floor.

marker.description: Name of an info_marker in the map.

yaw.description: Facing in degrees; 0 is east (+x), 90 is north (+y).

pitch.description: Pitch in degrees; positive looks up. Defaults to 0.

map_enemies.description: Spawn the map's own enemies too, before any listed in enemies. Defaults to false, so scenarios have only the enemies they list.

enemies.description: Enemies placed for this scenario, spawned after the map's (if any), in order. Each is dropped onto the floor below where it's placed, as map enemies are.

inputs.description: Consecutive segments. Each holds one set of inputs from the previous segment's end (or 0) until its own 'until'. After the last segment, inputs are neutral with the view held.

expect.description: Checks on the player's and enemies' state at given times.

enemy_spawn.description: One enemy, placed at a marker or a position (exactly one of the two).

marker.description: Name of an info_marker in the map.

position.description: Where to place it, in map coordinates.

yaw.description: Facing in degrees; 0 is east (+x), 90 is north (+y).

until.description: End time of this segment in seconds; must increase from segment to segment.

yaw.description: View yaw in degrees. Carries over from the previous segment (or the start) when omitted.

pitch.description: View pitch in degrees, positive up. Carries over when omitted.

jump.description: Hold jump. Defaults to false in each segment.

attack.description: Hold attack. Defaults to false in each segment.

at.description: Time in seconds at which to check.

note.description: Why this check matters, for whoever reads a failure.

position.description: Expected player origin; null skips an axis. Needs a tolerance.

velocity.description: Expected velocity in units per second; null skips an axis. Needs a tolerance.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference per checked axis of position, velocity, and last_hit.

health.description: The player's health (0 or less once dead).

near_marker.description: The player origin is within this distance of a marker's origin.

weapon.description: The weapon in hand, by its id in example/data/weapons.json. During a switch, the old weapon until it is fully lowered, then the new one while it raises.

shots.description: How many times the player has fired since the start, through this tick (a shotgun blast is one shot).

enemy.description: Checks on one enemy. Uses the expectation's tolerance for position.

index.description: The enemy's place in spawn order, from 0: the map's enemies (with map_enemies), then the scenario's.

position.description: Expected origin; null skips an axis. Needs a tolerance.

near_player.description: The enemy's origin is within this distance of the player's.

last_hit.description: Where the player's most recent pellet hit a wall or an entity, through this tick (a wall hit stops 1/32 short of the surface); null skips an axis. Needs a tolerance. Fails if nothing has been hit yet.
